cli.reason: Space Files origin classification adds a negotiated, non-breaking response capability. This CLI build sends an explicit x-openmeld-space-files-origin-version header on every Space Files request and gains the origin field plus the --all chat-uploads filter; an already-published CLI never sends that header and keeps receiving the exact pre-origin response shape it already parses, so it remains fully compatible without an update.

service.reason: The packaged Service bundle picked up shared package updates (packages/schemas, packages/gateway-contract, packages/api-client) from the same Space Files origin classification change, but Service never calls any Space Files endpoint or reads the origin field; its own Wake/dispatch/Prepare behavior and wire contracts are unchanged, so old and new Service remain compatible with old and new cloud in both directions.

skills.reason: The plugin guide adds optional commands without changing existing Wake or reply instructions; publish after the compatible cloud receivers.
